p6_obj_3.SP: The brown hawk hunts over the forest.
p6_obj_3.PC: The brown hawk is hunting over the forest.
p6_obj_3.PA: The brown hawk dived towards the meadow.
p6_obj_3.PX: The brown hawk was hunting when the rabbit ran into the bushes.
p6_obj_3.PP: The brown hawk has not caught anything yet.
p6_obj_3.GO: The brown hawk is going to land on a tall tree.
p6_obj_3.WI: The brown hawk will try again later.

p6_obj_11.PA: The beaver climbed onto the log and shook the water from its fur.
p6_obj_11.PX: The beaver was cleaning its fur when the squirrel ran past above.
p6_obj_11.PP: The beaver has finished its work for the night.
p6_obj_11.GO: The beaver is going to slide back into the stream.
p6_obj_11.WI: The beaver will swim back to the dam.

p6_obj_14.PX: The water was rushing over the white rocks.
p6_obj_14.PP: The water has made the white rocks smooth.
p6_obj_14.GO: The beaver is going to swim past the white rocks.

p6_obj_18.SP: The third wind turbine makes electricity.
p6_obj_18.PC: The third wind turbine is spinning in the wind.
p6_obj_18.PA: The third wind turbine spun all night.
p6_obj_18.PX: The third wind turbine was spinning fast when the wind got stronger.
p6_obj_18.PP: The third wind turbine has made a lot of electricity today.
p6_obj_18.GO: The third wind turbine is going to slow down when the wind drops.
p6_obj_18.WI: The third wind turbine will keep spinning tomorrow.

p6_obj_19.PC: The wooden lookout tower is standing above the trees.

p6_obj_36.SP: The snowy peak shines in the sun.
p6_obj_36.PC: The snowy peak is shining in the sun.
p6_obj_36.PA: Snow fell on the peak last night.
p6_obj_36.PX: The snowy peak was shining when the geese flew past.
p6_obj_36.PP: The peak has kept its snow all summer.
p6_obj_36.GO: The peak is going to turn pink at sunset.
p6_obj_36.WI: The peak will have even more snow in winter.

p6_obj_38.SP: The speckled osprey catches fish in the lake.
p6_obj_38.PC: The speckled osprey is soaring over the lake.
p6_obj_38.PA: The speckled osprey soared over the lake.
p6_obj_38.PX: The speckled osprey was soaring when it saw a fish.
p6_obj_38.PP: The osprey has caught two fish today.
p6_obj_38.GO: The osprey is going to dive into the water.
p6_obj_38.WI: The osprey will take the fish to its nest.

p6_obj_77.SP: The two raccoons play together every evening.
p6_obj_77.PC: The two raccoons are playing together.
p6_obj_77.PA: The two raccoons played together in the grass.
p6_obj_77.PX: The two raccoons were playing when the fox ran past.
p6_obj_77.PP: The two raccoons have played all evening.
p6_obj_77.GO: The two raccoons are going to look for food.
p6_obj_77.WI: The two raccoons will sleep in the hollow tree.

p6_obj_98.PA: Someone left the old car chassis in the grass long ago.

p6_obj_116.PC: The boy is walking along the fence with his arms folded.

p6_obj_145.PC: The plant on the cabinet is growing towards the window.

p6_obj_147.PC: The girl is kneeling and feeding her pet lizard.

p6_obj_164.PC: The Great Dane is sniffing at the fence.

p6_obj_165.SP: The orange cone warns people about the open manhole.
p6_obj_165.PC: The orange cone is standing beside the open manhole.
p6_obj_165.PA: The worker put the orange cone beside the manhole.
p6_obj_165.PX: The orange cone was standing there when the rats ran past.
p6_obj_165.PP: The cone has kept people away from the hole.
p6_obj_165.GO: The worker is going to move the cone when he finishes.
p6_obj_165.WI: The cone will go back in the van tonight.

p6_obj_185.SP: The goose floats on the pond.
p6_obj_185.PC: The goose is floating on the pond.

p6_obj_185.PX: The goose was floating on the pond when the swan opened its wings.
p6_obj_185.PP: The goose has floated to the middle of the pond.
p6_obj_185.GO: The goose is going to swim to the bank.
p6_obj_185.WI: The goose will sleep by the pond tonight.

p6_obj_186.PC: The turtle is sunbathing on the stone.
p6_obj_186.PA: The turtle climbed onto the warm stone.
p6_obj_186.PX: The turtle was sunbathing when the frog jumped into the water.
p6_obj_186.PP: The turtle has lain on the stone all morning.
p6_obj_186.GO: The turtle is going to slide back into the pond.
p6_obj_186.WI: The turtle will come back tomorrow.

p6_obj_187.SP: The tall bulrushes grow at the edge of the pond.
p6_obj_187.PC: The tall bulrushes are swaying in the breeze.
p6_obj_187.PA: The tall bulrushes swayed in the breeze.
p6_obj_187.PX: The bulrushes were swaying when the ducks swam past.
p6_obj_187.PP: The bulrushes have grown very tall this summer.
p6_obj_187.GO: Birds are going to hide in the bulrushes.
p6_obj_187.WI: The bulrushes will turn brown in autumn.

p6_obj_188.SP: The reeds grow in the shallow water.

p6_obj_188.PX: The reeds were moving in the wind.
p6_obj_188.PP: The reeds have grown thick this year.
p6_obj_188.GO: The ducklings are going to hide in the reeds.
p6_obj_188.WI: The reeds will turn yellow in autumn.

p6_obj_191.SP: The dragonfly hunts small insects over the pond.
p6_obj_191.PC: The dragonfly is hovering over the water.
p6_obj_191.PA: The dragonfly hovered over the water.
p6_obj_191.PX: The dragonfly was hovering when the frog jumped.
p6_obj_191.PP: The dragonfly has caught a small fly.
p6_obj_191.GO: The dragonfly is going to land on a lily pad.

p6_obj_215.SP: The yellow ducklings paddle behind their mother.
p6_obj_215.PC: The yellow ducklings are paddling in the pond.
p6_obj_215.PA: The yellow ducklings paddled across the pond.
p6_obj_215.PX: The ducklings were paddling when the butterfly flew over them.
p6_obj_215.PP: The ducklings have paddled to the lily pads.
p6_obj_215.GO: The ducklings are going to follow their mother home.

p6_obj_228.PP: The woman has used most of the water.
